about.title: 1. UI/UX Design
about.content: When I first started web development, I was drawn to how immediately the results could be visualized compared to other languages. Beyond simply implementing features, I became fascinated with designing interfaces that users can understand intuitively and use comfortably. Since then, I have continued to study and pay close attention to screen composition and user-flow design with the user experience in mind.

about.title: 2. Refactoring
about.content: While working on several personal projects, I kept asking myself, "Is there a better structure?" and "How can I improve readability?" This led me to form a habit of considering maintainability and scalability, not just functionality. I have grown increasingly interested in improving code quality through removing unnecessary duplication, separating responsibilities, and using clear naming. Going forward, I want to focus on writing sustainable code, not just implementing features.

about.title: 3. Expanding into Backend and Full-Stack Skills
about.content: I am currently focused on frontend development, but my long-term goal is to grow into a full-stack engineer who understands both frontend and backend. I have experience implementing authentication and data management features using Firebase, and I plan to study Prisma and PostgreSQL to strengthen my ability to design more structured data models and implement server-side logic.
